subproblem.title: Mass estimate for the smooth affine homotopy evaluated through the cylinder integral formula
subproblem.statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0, (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 and (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for all N, N', k, A : ℝ^N →L ℝ^{N'} and k-covectors β on ℝ^{N'}, and (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for all N, k, v ∈ ℝ^N and (k+1)-covectors β on ℝ^N (exactly the type of the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_covector_bounds). Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ, δ, b ∈ ℝ, F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} C^∞ with H(ι(t,x)) = F(x) + t•(G(x) − F(x)) for all t, x, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞, ‖DF(x)‖ ≤ Λ, ‖DG(x)‖ ≤ Λ and dist(F(x), G(x)) ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}) with |β(y)| ≤ b for all y, θ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with θ(ι(t,x)) = (β(H(ι(t,x)))).compContinuousLinearMap (DH(ι(t,x))) for t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X, and C ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v) = ω(ι(t,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J∘v)) for all t, x, v and C(ω) = ∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt. Then |C(θ)| ≤ δ·Λ^k·b·M(X).toReal.

F x)) → X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ Λ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ Λ) → (∀ x ∈ X.support, dist (F x) (G x) ≤ δ) → (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) y) ≤ b) → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ X.support, (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))))).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), ∃ η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ C ω = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (η t)) → |C θ| ≤ δ * Λ ^ k * b * X.mass.toReal
subproblem.natural_proof:
0. (A0) denotes the first conclusion of the sibling toolkit, available from (VO), (REP).
1. Apply the hypothesis on C to ω := θ: there is η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v) = θ(ι(t,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J∘v)) and C(θ) = ∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt.
2. Fix t ∈ [0,1] and x ∈ spt X; put y := ι(t,x), D := DH(y), u := G(x) − F(x) and A := DF(x) + t•(DG(x) − DF(x)) : ℝ^N →L ℝ^{N'}. Since F, G, H are C^∞ (hence differentiable), the sibling affine_homotopy (ii) gives D(e₀) = u and D(Jv) = A(v) for all v.
3. Representation: η_t(x) = ((β(H y)).curryLeft u).compContinuousLinearMap A as k-covectors. Indeed, for v : Fin k → ℝ^N, using the hypothesis on θ at (t,x), compContinuousLinearMap_apply, Fin.comp_cons and ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply (Matrix.vecCons = Fin.cons): η_t(x)(v) = θ(y)(Fin.cons e₀ (J∘v)) = β(H y)(D ∘ Fin.cons e₀ (J∘v)) = β(H y)(Fin.cons (D e₀) (D∘J∘v)) = β(H y)(Fin.cons u (A∘v)) = ((β(H y)).curryLeft u)(A∘v) = (((β(H y)).curryLeft u).compContinuousLinearMap A)(v).
4. Pointwise bound: by (L1) and then (L2), |η_t(x)| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|(β(H y)).curryLeft u| ≤ ‖A‖^k·‖u‖·|β(H y)|. Here ‖A‖ = ‖(1 − t)•DF(x) + t•DG(x)‖ ≤ (1 − t)‖DF(x)‖ + t‖DG(x)‖ ≤ Λ (0 ≤ t ≤ 1), so 0 ≤ ‖A‖^k ≤ Λ^k (pow_le_pow_left); ‖u‖ = dist(G x, F x) = dist(F x, G x) ≤ δ; 0 ≤ |β(H y)| ≤ b. All factors are nonnegative, so |η_t(x)| ≤ Λ^k·δ·b.
5. For each t ∈ [0,1] step 4 holds for every x ∈ spt X, so (A0) with c := Λ^k·δ·b gives |X(η_t)| ≤ (Λ^k·δ·b)·M(X).toReal (if spt X = ∅ the hypothesis of (A0) is vacuous and the conclusion still holds).
6. For t ∈ Ι 0 1 = Ioc 0 1 ⊆ Icc 0 1 the bound of step 5 applies, so intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const gives |C(θ)| = |∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt| ≤ (Λ^k δ b M(X).toReal)·|1 − 0| = δ·Λ^k·b·M(X).toReal.
